description: This Java class defines the 'RefreshSession' object, which signals that a WebSocket session should be refreshed. It contains fields for correlation ID, session timeout, and authorization context, with corresponding getters and a constructor.

classes.name: RefreshSession
classes.description: A simple event class indicating that a WebSocket session needs to be refreshed, carrying associated session details.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this refresh session.

methods.name: getSessionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the Instant when the session times out.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the AuthorizationContext for this session refresh.

methods.name: RefreshSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RefreshSession with correlation ID, session timeout, and authorization context.
